title: Intense and lost in mall world but not necessarily creepy or scary.
content: Last night was having a dream about being with family and friends at a pool outside of a large structure that led to mall world. I went in the structure in a towel and suit dripping wet to find a bathroom and instead got lost in mall world, my phone didn't work to contact my friends or family. It felt like a labyrinth and I couldn't find my way back to the pool. In the beginning there were classrooms, day cares, then to a white yellow tinged bathroom with cement floors and it made me realize I was barefoot and I felt the cringe of bare feet on wet painted cement floors, there was dusty mauve doors and fluorescent lighting that was unbearable. When I realized I hated this sensation I asked someone the way back to the family pool they pointed me in the wrong direction. I ended up in a multi level mall more narrow than I was used to, all the stairs were barren hallways that felt employee only and led to another level. I was able to interact with some of the stores and food counters. I was able to get flip flops and an oversized sweater but still was underdressed and I kept saying I was sorry I looked like this I was coming from the pool and trying to get back. Everyone kept pointing me in dif directions. I was in a huge almost Disney like elevator at one point that led to industrial out door areas and I went into thinking I could see the pool but when I couldn't I got scared I was going to get consumed and lost in this colorful structures yet barren industrial outer area. I did find a way back in through a glass Walled Chinese food center they made me sit for a tea and warm up and led me back through another series of hallway and stairs which some doors led to nothing and made me gasp, another led to an indoor pool that was sterile and dark and had old women stop mid laps and stare at me. I eventually found another way into the mall where at this point it was dark outside but the mall was crowded with npcs. I sort of eased into being or feeling safer at this mall than I did the halls, the industrial area, the weird pool and I found a place they had beds for sale but let people sleep in over night I just had to wait to be screened and soon after I woke up completely drenched.
